items.headline: Robert Griffin III says he is '100 percent' interested in Baylor coaching job
items.description: Robert Griffin III, Baylor's only Heisman Trophy winner, said Monday that he is interested in being the Bears' new football coach.

items.headline: Baylor interim Joe Klanderman wants to give 'jolt of energy'
items.description: Baylor interim coach Joe Klanderman hopes to provide a "jolt of energy" that he believes is desperately needed for the Bears as he takes over for the fired Dave Aranda.

items.headline: UCF's Frost: 'Don't think we'll have a letdown' after double-OT win vs. BYU
items.description: Coach Scott Frost is doubling down on intensity after UCF's double-overtime upset of BYU on Saturday, as the Knights prepare for their Friday night game against Baylor.
